item.title: Bad Bunny, Poor Super Bowl Ratings Could Have Lingering Effect on NFL's Popularity
item.description: Bad Bunny lost the most viewership from the second quarter to the halftime performance in Super Bowl history on Sunday.

item.title: Cougars Turn On Each Other After TikToker In His 20s Sleeps With One Of His Bored Housewife Fans
item.description: It was all fun and games for a Canadian gardener who started posting thirst trap content on TikTok of himself lip-syncing to hits from the 70s until it wasn’t. He grew a fan base of cougars who started sending him money.

item.title: Kirk Herbstreit Wants Power Four Conferences To Leave G5 Schools, Start New League
item.description: Kirk Herbstreit says the Power Four should ditch other conferences, appoint a commissioner, and create a CBA to stop the current chaos of NIL and the transfer portal.

item.title: Beauty Queen Slams Miss America Over Trans Policy: 'They Can't Even Define What A Woman Is'
item.description: Kayleigh Bush says the organization has “abandoned common-sense truth."

item.title: CNN Has Lost Nearly Half Its Audience And All Its Relevance In Past 8 Years
item.description: No network on television benefited more in the ratings from Trump’s first presidency than CNN. That is not the case the second time around.

item.title: NBA Hands Down Weak Suspensions After Pistons-Hornets Brawl Channeled The 90s
item.description: Isaiah Stewart got seven games, Jalen Duren received two, and both Moussa Diabate and Miles Bridges were hit with four games.

item.title: Manchester United Co-Owner Says UK Has Been 'Colonized' By Immigration
item.description: Manchester United owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe slams the UK government for allowing mass immigration and a massive benefits crisis to destroy the British economy.

item.title: Brittany Mahomes Shows NFL WAGs Heroically Battling The Cold Weather For Their SI Swimsuit Cover Shoot
item.description: The highlight of Super Bowl week was easily SI Swimsuit rolling out the NFL WAG content. They had six different covers featuring WAGs from around the league for their February digital issue.

item.title: MLB Hamate Chaos: Francisco Lindor, Corbin Carroll, Jackson Holliday All Need Surgery
item.description: Jackson Holliday, Mets shortstop Francisco Lindor, and Diamondbacks outfielder Corbin Carroll were all revealed to be dealing with hamate bone injuries — and all three are scheduled for surgery.

item.title: Kenneth Walker Fires Back At Seahawks GM’s Parade Contract Joke
item.description: If you thought the rainy city knew how to throw a party, you haven’t seen John Schneider with a red Solo cup and a Super Bowl ring.
